title: Introduce Chronicle circuit logger and soft-fall safeguard
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: during a regional incident we observed a sequence of rapid circuit flips with poor auditability that made post-incident debugging and targeted mitigation expensive. This PR introduces Chronicle, a lightweight per-circuit append-only logger plus a soft-fall safeguard layer that applies conservative admission holdoffs for circuits that flip more than threshold flips within a short window. The goals are: 1) capture a compact causal trace for circuit state transitions and decision inputs (metrics, KV pressure, probe failures) without adding high cardinality metrics; 2) provide a low-risk mitigation path (soft-fall) that gently drains in-flight requests and applies short probation windows instead of hard eviction to reduce oscillation; 3) surface actionable telemetry to SLO enforcers and the Console UI for faster remediation. Changes: added chronicle package (chronicle::logger.go) that serializes circuit events to a rotating local store with size-bounded segments and an async uploader to the control-plane telemetry endpoint; added softfall controller (softfall/controller.go) implementing a configurable flip-count detector and probabilistic holdoff backoff; wired logging hooks into the connection manager and circuit manager paths; added feature flag redwood.runtime.chronicle.enabled and a rate-limited uploader to avoid telemetry storms; added unit and integration tests covering flip scenarios and uplink backpressure. Safety: default flag is off for all customers; soft-fall applies only to tenant-scoped circuits and is bounded by a duration and max-probation-count to avoid tenant lockout; uploader uses existing telemetry auth/queueing. Rollout plan: stage to canary and then ramp regionally with telemetry dashboards tracking circuit flip rate, probation counts, and SLO delta. See linked Linear ENG-2145 for rollout checklist. Commit summary, changed areas, review notes, CI checks, and merge details follow.
commits: Initial chronicle logger implementation and segment writer
Soft-fall controller with flip detector and backoff policy
Wire chronicle hooks into circuit manager and connection lifecycle
Add feature flag, telemetry uploader, and tests
Fix race in segment rotation (addressed by reviewer Arjun)
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Found a race on segment rotation when uploader lags behind writes; added a suggested mutex scope reduction and a simple backpressure counter. Please add a unit test for rotation under delay.
Maya Chen: Addressed race by switching to an epoch token on the writer and added integration test simulating slow network for uploader. Also added a backpressure metric 'chronicle.uploader.backlog'.

Sofia Rivera: Can we make probation window configurable per-tenant? Concerned about tenant lockout on small tenants. Suggest max-probation-count default of 3 and per-tenant override via account config.
Maya Chen: Implemented per-tenant override and capped the global max to prevent runaway settings. Added docs entry and a caution in the rollout checklist.
Liam O'Connor: CI flake in integration test due to test timeouts; reduced sleeps and used condition wait. Verified locally with stress harness.
SRE-ENG: Please coordinate canary in us-west-2 and enable verbose chronicle uploads for first 6 hours for debugging.
QA: test matrix updated to include circuit flip scenarios and soft-fall interaction with KV cache drains.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash-merge after 2 approvals. No conflicts. Rollback plan documented in ENG-2145 with a kill switch redwood.runtime.chronicle.enabled=false and an operator guide for manually clearing probationed tenants.
release_notes: Added Chronicle per-circuit event logger and a soft-fall safeguard to reduce circuit flip oscillation. Feature is off by default and requires feature-flag rollout. Improves diagnosability and provides a conservative mitigation path during SLO pressure.
notes_for_release: Enable behind feature flag. Recommend canary in low-traffic region for 24h with telemetry sampling=100% for first 6h, then 10% afterwards. Monitor emails to SRE pager for probation spikes.
